scientific_integrity: An unrestricted two-parameter proof by exact local simplicial decomposition, relative elementary collapses, and nullhomotopic attaching maps. A standalone checker independently enumerates small profiles; finite experiments are corroborative, not a substitute for the uniform proof.
scientific_limitations: Only one-point bouquets of unfilled triangles and squares with both petal counts positive, and the full strong discrete-Morse matching complex. Does not classify other polygon lengths, pure or ordinary Morse variants, or equivariant homotopy; scientific priority and proof remain subject to independent review.
title: A sharp two-square transition for strong Morse complexes of mixed polygon bouquets
